sections.Profile:
The Egg Head pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1961, was designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. This electro-mechanical game features a school-themed layout, incorporating elements of tic-tac-toe and robots, which was quite innovative for its time.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
